question: What is the meaning of reused parts percentage out of the total product mass in relation to reused content?
data_point: reused parts percentage out of the total product mass
description: The meaning of the reused parts percentage out of the total product mass in relation to reused content is that it specifies the mass fraction of reused parts present in the product, expressed as a percentage of the total mass of the product. This information is important for indicating the extent to which reused components contribute to the overall composition of the product.
